question: Who won the 2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Armand “Mondo” Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armand “Mondo” Duplantis**, the legendary **Swedish-American** pole vaulter, has been honored as the **2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year**. This prestigious award recognizes his unparalleled dominance and extraordinary achievements in the sport of **Athletics** throughout the preceding year.
 
• During the **2024** season, which served as the qualifying period for this award, Duplantis broke the **Pole Vault world record** on **three** separate occasions. He ended the year with a staggering height of **6.26 meters**, achieved at the **Silesia Diamond League** in **August 2024**.
 
• One of his most significant highlights was winning the **Gold Medal** at the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games**. In front of a capacity crowd at the **Stade de France**, he not only secured the Olympic title but also set a new **Olympic Record** and **World Record** of **6.25 meters** during the final. ***Hence, the statement regarding his victory is correct.***
 
• This victory marks the **first time** a track and field athlete specializing in a field event has taken home the top honor since the inception of the awards, highlighting the global impact of his "Mondo-mania" performances.
 
• The **Laureus World Sports Academy**, composed of **71** sporting legends, voted for Duplantis over other high-profile nominees, including **Formula 1** star **Max Verstappen** and **Real Madrid** footballer **Jude Bellingham**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Laureus World Sports Awards:**
 
 
• Often referred to as the **“Oscars of Sport,”** these awards were established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont**.
 
• The first ceremony took place on **May 25, 2000**, in **Monte Carlo**, with **Nelson Mandela** delivering a famous speech about how "sport has the power to change the world."
 
• The awards celebrate the most remarkable sporting achievements of the calendar year across multiple categories, including **World Sportswoman of the Year**, **World Team of the Year**, and **World Breakthrough of the Year**.
 
 
 
• **Profile of Armand Duplantis:**
 
 
• Born in **Lafayette, Louisiana**, in **November 1999**, Duplantis represents **Sweden** internationally, the home country of his mother.
 
• He has dominated the **Diamond League** circuit and holds multiple **World Championship** titles (**2022** and **2023**) in addition to his **two Olympic Gold medals** (**Tokyo 2020** and **Paris 2024**).
 
• By the age of **25**, he has broken the world record **ten times**, establishing himself as one of the greatest athletes in history.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Nominees:**
 
 
• **Max Verstappen**: A **three-time** Laureus nominee and **2022 winner**, who continued his dominance in **Formula 1**.
 
• **Cristiano Ronaldo**: Though a legend of **Football**, he was not the winner of the **2025** Sportsman category, despite his ongoing record-breaking career in **Saudi Arabia**.
 
• **Usain Bolt**: A **four-time** winner of the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year (**2009, 2010, 2013, 2017**), he remains the most decorated athlete in the history of this specific award.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Selection Process:** The shortlist is created by a panel of over **1,000** sports journalists from more than **70 countries**. The final winner is then selected by a secret ballot of the **Laureus World Sports Academy**.
 
• **Social Impact:** The awards also support the **Laureus Sport for Good Foundation**, which funds over **250** programs in **40 countries**, using sport to tackle social issues such as violence, discrimination, and disadvantage.
